cues.text: I am Chung-Kuang Chen from National Taiwan University of Science and Technology.
In industrial non-intrusive load monitoring, calibration labels are often scarce.
We ask whether an LLM proposes more useful calibration candidates than structured sampling under a small evaluation budget, and how engineering bounds change the answer.
Our result is conditional: the relative advantage depends on bounds and on how performance is summarized.
